title: Increased morning cortisol levels across different mood states in bipolar disorder: A systematic review and meta-analysis
title_zh: 双相情感障碍不同情绪状态下晨间皮质醇水平升高：系统综述与荟萃分析
abstract: OBJECTIVE: Bipolar disorder (BD) is associated with hypothalamic-pituitary-adrenal (HPA) axis dysregulation. However, findings regarding morning cortisol levels across different mood states remain inconsistent. This systematic review and meta-analysis aimed to synthesize evidence on morning cortisol levels in BD across different mood states, while considering the effects of various clinical moderators. METHODS: A systematic search of seven databases was conducted for articles published up to August 31, 2026. Studies were included if they reported cortisol levels measured under eligible morning sampling protocols in BD patients and healthy controls. A total of 39 studies (n = 3611) were included. A multilevel mixed-effects meta-analysis was applied to account for the dependence of mood-state subgroups within studies. Moderator analyses were conducted via meta-regression. RESULTS: Compared with healthy controls, BD patients exhibited significantly elevated morning cortisol levels, both overall and across specific mood states. In exploratory moderator analyses, earlier age at onset was associated with higher morning-cortisol, whereas a greater proportion of participants receiving medication was associated with lower morning cortisol after adjustment for mood state. CONCLUSION: BD is associated with a significant elevation in morning cortisol across mood states. This pattern is consistent with a potential trait-related component of HPA-axis dysregulation, although its expression may vary with clinical state and sampling conditions.
abstract_zh: 目标：双相情感障碍（BD）与下丘脑-垂体-肾上腺（HPA）轴功能失调相关。然而，关于不同情绪状态下晨间皮质醇水平的研究结果不一致。本系统综述与荟萃分析旨在综合不同情绪状态下BD患者晨间皮质醇水平的证据，并考虑多种临床调节因素的影响。方法：对七个数据库进行系统检索，纳入截至2026年8月31日发表的文章。若研究报告了符合晨间采样方案的BD患者与健康对照的皮质醇水平，则纳入。共纳入39项研究（n=3611）。采用多层次混合效应荟萃分析，以处理研究内情绪状态子组的相关性。通过荟萃回归进行调节因子分析。结果：与健康对照相比，BD患者整体及各情绪状态下的晨间皮质醇水平显著升高。在探索性调节因子分析中，发病年龄较早与晨间皮质醇升高相关，而接受药物治疗的比例较高则在调整情绪状态后与晨间皮质醇降低相关。结论：双相情感障碍在不同情绪状态下均表现出显著的晨间皮质醇升高。这一模式与HPA轴功能失调的潜在特质相关成分一致，尽管其表达可能随临床状态和采样条件而变化。
